title: 1558. Minimum Numbers of Function Calls to Make Target Array

examples.explanation: Increment by 1 (second element): [0, 0] to get [0, 1] (1 operation). Double all the elements: [0, 1] -> [0, 2] -> [0, 4] (2 operations). Increment by 1 (both elements)  [0, 4] -> [1, 4] -> [1, 5] (2 operations). Total of operations: 1 + 2 + 2 = 5.
Increment by 1 (both elements) [0, 0] -> [0, 1] -> [1, 1] (2 operations). Double all the elements: [1, 1] -> [2, 2] (1 operation). Total of operations: 2 + 1 = 3.
